direction_notes: No group-level change in MEP amplitude after tbTUS at the precentral target or at either 3 cm control site at any time point.
safety_notes: No participants reported any side effects.

exposures.label: tbTUS of left M1-HAND (anterior wall of precentral sulcus); anterior and posterior sites 3 cm away served as active controls

timing.protocol_description: Theta burst TUS after Zeng et al. (2022): burst length 20 ms, period 200 ms, duty cycle 10%, duration 80 s. Free-field output was measured with a 10 ms pulse and 10 ms interval (100% duty cycle) at 9.10 W/cm2 Isppa.
